scope: 2F0 integrity only, before any model fitting. No inference, calibration, masks, image previews, exclusions, new category payloads or publication.

source.attribution: Zou, Jeong, Pemula, Zhang and Dabeer, SPot-the-Difference, ECCV 2022; preserve source, license, notices and modifications.

resource_monitoring: Process PeakWorkingSetSize checked before each extraction/decode, every1000 comparisons and after scan. Wall cap600s. Bounds are fail-closed; no clean result from truncated scan. Candidate overflow keeps one sentinel candidate and returns incomplete.
candidate_budget_rationale: 250000 replaces the recovery proposal100000 before any PCB2 access, to cover newly required within-development and within-test comparisons as well as cross-split; same2GiB peak and600s cap.
identity: ByteSHA256 and decodedSHA256 of ASCII RGB:width:height: followed by raw RGB bytes; no EXIF rotation. Reject nontrivial orientation, multi-frame, non-JPEG/PNG, decode errors.
ordering: Opaque audit ID pcb2- plus first24 hex SHA256 of exact official image path; sorted audit ID for all comparisons/ties. Preserve path/sample-ID mapping only in inventory.

similarity.fingerprints: existing64-bit horizontal dHash;63 AC-bit32x32DCT pHash;RGB32 LANCZOS /255
similarity.refinement: full-frameRGB128 LANCZOS RMS; central half-width/half-height crop resized64 LANCZOS RGB RMS; centered64x64 grayscale Pearson; zero norm=>null
similarity.strong: (full128_RMS<=0.015 AND crop64_RMS<=0.025) OR (correlation not null AND correlation>=0.995)
similarity.required_review: All nonexact strong pairs plus union first8fullRMS, first8cropRMS and first8SHA256(a|b) within each relation; exact pairs are resolved mechanically; ties IDs; required nonexact pairs remain unresolved without independent evidence.
similarity.classification: Perceptual proximity never confirms duplication. No image preview or subjective content review in2F0. No automatic visual rejection. All selected nonexact pairs are unresolved; other broad candidates are unadjudicated.
similarity.groups: Connected components from exact byte/pixel edges plus independently confirmed near-duplicate edges only. Uncertain edges not merged into confirmed groups.
similarity.physical_independence: unknown; no physical serial IDs/batch provenance; no absence-of-all-near-duplicate claim

metadata: Parse official split labels for membership/counts/contradictory identical-content labels only. No labels enter fingerprints, pair selection or refinement. Header-check category image/mask membership exactly; extract and decode images only, no mask payloads.

verdicts.PASS: Verified source/protocol, all expected images decoded, allpairs complete, no confirmed cross-split component/materialdefect, mandatory review resolved within cap. Not proof of physical independence.
verdicts.BLOCKED: Verified source and material defect (corrupt/missing/unsafe/contradictory evidence) or confirmed official train/test overlap. Preserve all samples; no repair.
verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: Identity/resource/technical limitation, incomplete checks, >200 required reviews, or any unresolved mandatory pair. No clean inference.

exclusion_policy: None. Never remove, relabel, reassign or replace samples. Within-split exact groups preserved for future grouping; a repair proposal requires separate authorization.

outputs.fields: Original inventory and source-byte hashes; opaque-ID mapping, dimensions, exactgroups, all candidates with refinement, required/unresolved pairs, explicit completeness/failures/verdict, CPU/wall/peak, zero mask/model/preview counters.
outputs.exclusive: New root and x-mode writes; existing root refuses a rerun; original archive/split remain unchanged.
